The big volcano is about to erupt, and all of the dinosaurs need to get to the island before the lava fills the valley. Work together to move all of the dinosaurs through the valley and onto the island. In this cooperative game, kids ages 4+ will work together to move all the dinosaurs across the board and onto the islands. Players use one of their cards to move a dinosaur onto a matching space on the board. The dinosaurs don’t share spaces, so players can get the dinosaurs really moving by playing the same item card twice and jumping over other dinosaurs! Mixed into the item cards are lava cards and when a player draws a lava card the lava moves one space closer to the valley. Players must get all the dinosaurs onto the island before the lava token reaches the bottom of the volcano. The bright and colorful image-based gameplay makes Baby Dinosaur Rescue easy to learn and fun to play! Once players know the rules there is no reading required which makes this a fun way for kids to use basic strategy skills and reduces competition by having the players work together to beat the game. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Contents 1 Objective 2 Gameplay 3 Game End 4 Cards 5 ELO Objective Get the herd of baby dinosaurs off the Island before the volcano explodes! Gameplay At the start of the game each player draws three cards. On your turn: When you have a lava card in your hand you must play it on your turn. Move the lava token one (1) space closer to the bottom. When you don't have a lava card, play an item card to move any dinosaur to the first corresponding space towards the island. If there is already a dinosaur on the closest item space, move the dinosaur to the next available space. If there are no unoccupied corresponding spaces left on the path, the dinosaur leaps to the island! Draw a new card (hand of three). The next player starts a new turn. Game End The players win once all the dinosaurs make it off the island. The players lose if the lava token reaches the bottom and time runs out. Cards 6x Dino Egg 6x Dino Print 6x Fern 6x Fish Bone 6x Meat 6x Snail 13x Lava ELO The ELO to earn depends on the number of players and options. The situation at the end of the game does not affect players: P tokens: T time limit: TL Removed item cards: C ELO=PT(4+TL+C)÷4 (Round down after the decimal point) In other words When "TL+C" is 0, the ELO to be earned are the "tokens×players" In addition to this, if "TL+C" increases by 1, 25% ELO will increase. community_text:
[Rating: 1/10] Co-op logic puzzle.  Cute theming and light play should work with kids and there isn't any extraneous nonsense.  Not for gamers.

[Rating: 2/10] Was decent fun and a very simple game, but lacking in decision spaces. Comes down to good cards being drawn to complete harder modes. Works as a co-op family game but not something I am drawn to play again.

[Rating: 2/10] Easy kids game. Not much strategy..just a move as far a you can game. I was not impressed.  Not a challenge or really any struggle only reason this isn't a 1 os because might be a fun kids game

[Rating: 2/10] Otherwise known as Hoot Owl Hoot but with cute baby dinosaurs...decisions are obvious and maybe work with really young children???

[Rating: 2/10] Stumbled upon this on BGA, not realising it was aimed at children. Expected something like Pandemic, but breezed through the entire game with no challenge, hard decisions, or much of a game, really.  Might be good for kids, but not for me!
